metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2026 · Nari Nari Naduma Murari
metas.description: Caught between two women, a young man navigates a complex love triangle while dealing with emotions and life-changing choices that affect both his romantic and family relationships.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Anaganaga Oka Raju
metas.description: A lazy, entitled brat who wants to lead an easy life is in for a rude shock that changes the course of his life.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Bhartha Mahasayulaku Wignyapthi
metas.description: What begins as a casual fling between a married man, Ram a.k.a Satya and Manasa in the middle of an international business trip, balloons into an out-of-the-blue mess when the latter lands in Hyderabad, disrupting Ram’s otherwise stable marriage with Balamani.

metas.name: ★ 3.1 · 2026 · The Raja Saab
metas.description: A young heir embraces both his royal heritage and rebellious spirit as he rises to power, establishing unprecedented rules during his reign as Raja Saab.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Psych Siddhartha
metas.description: Siddharth's life is a string of misfortunes, losing love, money, and dignity, making him the unwitting star of a slum-based comedy of errors. Hope only reappears in the form of Shravya, a no-nonsense single mother. However, just as Siddharth begins to rebuild his life and pursue a chance at love, his past resurfaces to threaten everything.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · Raakaasa
metas.description: Returning home after a decade, an NRI chasing romance inadvertently awakens an ancient darkness long feared by his village. As the threat intensifies, love turns deadly and life hangs in the balance.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2026 · Korean Kanakaraju
metas.description: Possessed by a Korean spirit, Kanakaraju must navigate his new supernatural identity to protect his family and solve the spirit's murder.

metas.name: ★ 4.1 · 2026 · Ustaad Bhagat Singh
metas.description: A tribal boy is shaped by the values of his teacher, who gives him the name 'Bhagat Singh'. He grows up deeply rooted in strong morals, which guide his actions throughout his life.He stands firm against injustice and takes on powerful evil forces, even when facing overwhelming odds.

metas.name: ★ 4.7 · 2026 · Gaayapadda Simham
metas.description: Follows Indians facing challenges while trying to travel to the USA and the struggles they encounter after reaching there.

metas.name: ★ 4.9 · 2026 · Papam Pratap
metas.description: A rural comedy drama about a soft spoken man whose life turned upside down after he married his childhood love.

metas.name: ★ 4.6 · 2026 · Oh..! Sukumari
metas.description: Follows an aspiring politician who falls in love with Sukumari, a beautiful and soft-natured woman, while her father conceals a secret that threatens their relationship.

metas.name: ★ 4.6 · 2026 · Mr. Work from Home
metas.description: A young corporate worker relocates to his village and works remotely. While there, he develops a passion for agriculture and applies his expertise to modernize farming practices.

metas.name: ★ 4.0 · 2026 · Funky
metas.description: A debut director who falls in love with his producer's daughter

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · Sing Geetham
metas.description: In an isolated village, young Prathap seeks opportunity but enters a world of deception. Drawn into uncontrollable forces, he's caught between progress and preservation, testing his beliefs and purpose.
